independent_and_esa.what_changed: The family moves from FREE_LANE_UNPROVEN to FREE_LANE_PARTIAL. Attended Chrome reached every page and bound every identity, so access is not the constraint. Roughly a third publish a policy at all. The rest are silent, and silence is not something a paid provider can buy -- the same fetch would return the same absent policy.

firecrawl.why: Nothing in current state produces a qualified need. IHG and Choice are closed free; Marriott and Hilton are unreachable to Firecrawl (PTF-FIRECRAWL-HARD-LANES-003); and the independents' problem is unpublished policy, which no provider fixes.
